config.label: Base URL of the RFP Hub API
config.description: Base URL of the RFP Hub API. Defaults to https://api.rfpsear.ch. The origin of this URL is bound into every write approval.

config.label: RFP Hub API credential
config.description: RFP Hub API credential. Needed ONLY to submit; searching and fetching are anonymous and never send it. Setting it is what registers the write tool at all: without it tools/list returns two tools. The key must carry the write scope and must not carry publish; the server checks that before its first submission, so a submission waits for a reviewer's decision.
